items.title: Karl Berger interviewed by Monk Rowe, Woodstock, New York, August 11, 2014
items.q: We just played in Berlin with a guy Han Bennink.

ctx.x: I was just going to ask about that.

No, Blackwell doesn’t read. He never read. But he is so fast, like you know, you could write the most intricate pattern and he will play it and next time he’ll play a new version of it and everyone will be perfect. He was such a perfectionist in every way. But you could not pin him down on a pattern. You couldn’t tell Blackwell what to play. He would come up with the patterns. But every take would be a different pattern he would come up with. So he was like one of a kind. We just played in Berlin with a guy Han…
That being in the moment, I know you both have talked about that. When you’re doing — let me rephrase — I saw a couple of things in your Columbia interview that I felt were important.
